name: SupaEasy
summary: No-code Shopify Functions generator (by Nextools): build and migrate custom discount, checkout, payment, shipping and validation logic from the Shopify Admin, with a migrator for deprecated Scripts and an AI generator that writes functions from a plain-language brief.
best_for: Shopify merchants — especially non-Plus stores — who want custom discount, checkout, payment and shipping logic without hiring a developer, and above all those forced to migrate deprecated Shopify Scripts to Functions before the cutoff
skip_if: you only need a simple volume discount (a dedicated discount app is cheaper), you are comfortable writing Shopify Functions in code yourself, or you will not pay $99 a month to use the AI generator on a live store — the free plan runs on a dev store only
honest_knock: Two things the marketing glosses over. First, the 'free' plan is development-stores only, so any live use is paid, and the AI generator that headlines the app is not in Premium ($49) but in Advanced ($99), plus AI credits bought separately ($25 per 50) — so the AI promise realistically costs $99+ a month. Second, the rating is suspiciously spotless — 5.0 across 233 reviews, all five-star, on the App Store listing on 29 September 2026 — and the praise dwells on fast human support (Andrea, Fabio) more than on the no-code AI running unattended, which hints the tool can need hand-holding.

pricing.notes: (verified 2026-08-28 on apps.shopify.com/supaeasy and supaeasy.com/pricing, and unchanged when re-read on 2026-09-29) A free plan plus three paid monthly tiers, each with a 7-day trial. The catch is in the free plan: it works only on a development store, not a live one. Premium is $49 a month ($470 a year), Advanced is $99 a month ($950 a year) and Ultimate is $399 a month ($3,830 a year). The headline feature — the AI Functions Generator, which writes a function from a plain-language description — does not appear until Advanced at $99, alongside the Scripts Editor, the Functions Wizard and the Scripts Migrator, and the App Store listing prices AI credits for it separately: $25 per 50, $40 per 100 or $149 per 500. So using SupaEasy the way it markets itself, on a live store, realistically starts at $99 a month.

compare_with.name: Shopify Functions
compare_with.why: SupaEasy is a no-code layer over Shopify Functions — the same platform capability a developer would code by hand. With engineering time, native Functions cost nothing but your developer's hours; SupaEasy is for merchants who would rather describe the logic than write it, and who need the Scripts migrator. Weigh the subscription against a freelancer's one-off build
